name: ape-style-markdown
description: Apply consistent, professional Markdown formatting rules whenever producing or reformatting Markdown output. Use this skill when generating any Markdown document, when the user asks to reformat or clean up existing Markdown, when producing README files, technical docs, notes, or any other content that will be rendered as Markdown. Trigger even when the request seems simple -- any Markdown output should follow these rules. Do not use this skill for non-Markdown outputs such as plain text, HTML, or code-only responses.
